# Contributing to ktalk (public mirror)

**Source of truth:** development of this plugin happens on an internal GitLab
instance, which is the source of truth. This GitHub repository is a
**one-way, read-only mirror** of the release payload (ADR-027) — it receives
no code from GitHub, and nothing you push or merge here changes the internal
repository automatically.

## What this means for you

- Issues and pull requests opened here are **not** automatically merged,
  closed, or synchronized anywhere. There is no bot, no CI job, and no
  workflow that acts on the content of an issue or a PR body.
- A maintainer reviews new issues and PRs manually and, if accepted, transfers
  them into the internal backlog by hand, with a link back to the original
  GitHub thread.
- Because triage is manual, response time here can be slower than on a
  project whose primary tracker is GitHub itself.

## How to contribute

1. Open an issue describing the bug or the change you would like to see.
2. If you already have a fix, open a pull request against `main` — it will be
   reviewed and, if accepted, ported to the internal repository by a
   maintainer (not merged directly on GitHub).
3. Do not include secrets, tokens, or personal data in an issue or a PR —
   this repository is public.

Thank you for your interest in ktalk.
